standard.title: Si + Present (General Truths)
standard.explanation: The word 'si' (if) followed by the present tense expresses general truths and habitual conditions. Example: 'Si tu travailles, tu réussis.' (If you work, you succeed.) The structure is: si + present tense, present tense (or imperative). Another example: 'Si tu as faim, mange quelque chose!' (If you are hungry, eat something!). Important: 'si' becomes 's'' only before the pronouns 'il' and 'ils' — never before 'je', 'tu', 'elle', 'nous', 'vous', 'elles'. Example: Si tu étudies... (not 's'tu étudies').

examples.english: If you are hungry, eat something.

advanced.title: Si + Present — General Truths, First Conditional & Common Patterns
advanced.explanation: The conjunction 'si' (if) + present tense serves two main functions: (1) expressing general truths and habitual conditions: 'Si tu travailles, tu réussis' (If you work, you always succeed). (2) Beginning the first conditional: 'Si + présent, futur simple' (If you study, you will succeed / Si tu étudies, tu réussiras). At A1 level, both patterns use present + present or present + imperative. Important: 'si' becomes 's'' only before 'il' and 'ils' (s'il vient, s'ils arrivent) — never before other pronouns (si tu, si je, si elle, si nous, si vous, si elles). When 'si' starts a sentence, it is never followed by inversion ('Si tu as faim...' not 'Si as-tu faim...?').

standard.scenario: Tell a friend about your school subjects and which ones you like best.
standard.modelAnswer: Bonjour! Je vais au lycée. Ma matière préférée est le français. J'aime aussi les maths. Comme matières, j'ai français, maths, anglais et histoire.
standard.modelAnswerExplanation: You greet your friend, mention your school, state your favorite subject, and list your subjects. This is a natural way to describe your school schedule.
standard.tip: Use 'ma matière préférée est' to say your favorite subject. Always use 'le', 'la', or 'les' before subject names.

advanced.scenario: Discuss your academic interests with a classmate. Talk about which subjects you enjoy studying, how you prepare for exams, and what grades you usually get.
advanced.modelAnswer: Mon domaine préféré est l'histoire. J'étudie surtout les sciences et les mathématiques. Pour les examens, je travaille deux heures par jour. Habituellement, j'ai une bonne note en français et une note correcte en maths.
advanced.modelAnswerExplanation: You discuss your preferences, study habits, and typical grades. This shows your engagement with your studies and helps build conversation with peers.
advanced.tip: Use varied vocabulary: 'préférer', 'étudier surtout', 'travailler pour les examens'. Mention your study habits and grades to make the conversation more natural.
